name: Minamoto no Tsunenobu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 71); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1096.

poems.title: This autumn night the wind blows shrill
poems.author: Minamoto no Tsunenobu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 71
poems.text:
This autumn night the wind blows shrill,
And would that I could catch
Its message, as it whistles through
The rushes in the thatch
And leaves of my rice-patch.

poems.title: 71. 夕されば 門田の稲葉 おとづれて (Yu sareba kadota no inaba otozurete)
poems.author: Minamoto no Tsunenobu
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 金葉集
poems.text:
夕されば 門田の稲葉 おとづれて
あしのまろやに 秋風ぞ吹く
